name: Ruined City
roomText: You are standing at the crossroads of a ruined city block.
You're in a maintenance shop, shelves stripped bare.
You see rubble everywhere; the street has collapsed into it.
A flickering streetlamp buzzes over cracked asphalt.
Broken glass crunches underfoot outside a gutted storefront.

name: The Rust Quarter
roomText: Everything here has rusted to the same flaking orange.
A collapsed overpass makes a low iron ceiling.
Stripped car husks are stacked three high.
Something drips, steady and metallic, in the dark.

name: The Neon Undercity
roomText: Flickering neon signage buzzes over a flooded platform.
Rusted turnstiles block a half-collapsed tunnel.
A vending machine hums, selling nothing anyone recognizes.
Graffiti tags cover every surface of this transit hub.
Dead screens line the wall, all showing the same frozen frame.

name: The Drowned Sprawl
roomText: Black water laps at your knees between the buildings.
A rooftop garden has become a reeking swamp.
Drowned traffic lights still cycle under the surface.
Something large turns over in the water and is gone.

name: The Ashfall Wastes
roomText: Ash drifts in slow spirals over a dead highway.
A skeletal billboard creaks in the wind.
Sand has swallowed half of what was once a plaza.
The ground is warm here, and nothing grows.
Grey dunes roll to the horizon in every direction.

name: The Undercroft
roomText: The ceiling is lost somewhere far above in the dark.
Pale roots hang through cracks in the stone.
A vast buried hall, its pillars worn smooth by seeping water.
Your footsteps come back to you a half-second late.

name: The Buried Reaches
roomText: Flooded galleries stretch away beneath the world.
Bioluminescent scum lights the water a faint green.
An archive of ruined books silts up a side chamber.
The pressure in your ears never quite equalizes.

name: The Frostbound Vaults
roomText: Frost has grown over every surface in feathered sheets.
A sealed blast door, rimed shut, stands half open.
Your breath hangs and does not disperse.
Ice-locked machinery lines the walls of this vault.
Something under the ice has the shape of a hand.

name: The Glacier Deeps
roomText: A blue-black crevasse drops away past the reach of light.
The walls here are old ice, full of trapped bubbles.
A frozen river hangs mid-fall down the shaft.
It is so cold the air feels solid.

name: The Shattered Orbital
roomText: A ring corridor curves up and away in both directions.
Stars wheel slowly past a cracked observation port.
Loose debris drifts through the failed artificial gravity.
Warning placards float, unmoored, in the dead air.
The hull groans as the station's spin decays.

name: The Vacuum Reaches
roomText: Torn hull plating opens onto absolute black.
Everything not bolted down has long since drifted away.
Frozen atmosphere coats the walls in white crystal.
Your own breathing is the only sound there is.

name: The Chronofracture
roomText: Reality stutters; the same moment happens twice.
A corridor folds back into itself here.
Shards of frozen time hang in the air like glass.
You see yourself, a room away, not yet arrived.
The light arrives before whatever cast it.

name: The Long Now
roomText: Every clock in the room reads a different century.
Dust falls upward, slowly, and settles on the ceiling.
A single instant, stretched thin enough to walk through.
Nothing here has moved in ten thousand years, including you.

name: The Final Instant
roomText: The end of the timeline is a white, soundless room.
There is no 'next' here. Only this.
Everything that will ever happen has already finished.
The air tastes of the last second before a storm.
